note: Defects found by this pass's own tests, fuzzing and gates while implementing v4.3.0. Each has a deterministic regression test.

defects.summary: service.py caught _StructuredPollError, which is a mixin and not a BaseException, so every lifecycle/identity refusal crashed with TypeError instead of a PK_POLL_ERROR/1.
defects.fix: catch Exception and re-raise anything not structured

defects.summary: validate_config serialised the document before validating it, so non-JSON values raised a bare TypeError.
Code accepted unknown provenance keys that the JSON schema rejects -- two definitions of one contract disagreed.
defects.fix: exact provenance key set + 256-char bound in code

defects.summary: Fault F5 ran verify_release, which ran the test suite, which ran F5: unbounded recursion.
gen_contracts regenerated the code registry and WIT enum but not the enum inside pk_poll_error.schema.json, so a new code left the schema stale.

defects.found_by: clean-room run from the archive (fresh venv, no site-packages)
defects.summary: Signing and one signing test silently required the third-party `cryptography` package; in a clean environment test_p2 failed although it passed in the development tree.
defects.fix: openssl CLI is a full keygen/sign/verify fallback; the cross-backend comparison skips only when one backend is absent
